The key finding is a deliberate conversion/simplification layer: when creating a `point_distance` on two points that are endpoints of the same line, the C++ core silently converts it to a `line_length` dimension (and vice-versa when creating a `line_length` where a `point_distance` already exists, the old one is removed). Both ultimately map to the same planegcs `ConstraintP2PDistance` constraint in the solver.
